title: Missing import of optparse
detail: The function get_path_completion_type uses optparse.SUPPRESS_HELP and optparse.Option, but optparse is not imported in this module, leading to a NameError at runtime.

title: Unprotected import of vendor module
detail: The function now calls importlib.import_module without handling ImportError. If the vendor module is missing or cannot be imported, this will raise an exception and crash the debug command.

title: Missing module existence check before accessing version
detail: After changing get_module_from_module_name to always return a ModuleType, the code no longer checks if the module was successfully imported. If the import failed, the subsequent code will still run and may raise AttributeError or other errors.
